decisions.rationale: Six days post-signup with zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone, no tickets. Two outreach emails ([email:5298db4f], [email:779d82c0]) went unanswered, showing no engagement signal. Starter plan, single admin. Silent accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand getting Harbor Partners' first project up
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Checking in now that you've had your workspace for a week. If you haven't started yet, the quickest way in is creating a first project — projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and you can invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
